voiceSummary: Polycab India Limited has intimated the schedule of investor meetings pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company will hold a one-on-one meeting with ICICI Securities in person in Mumbai on November 20, 2026. A UK non-deal roadshow organized by Citi Group or one-on-one meetings will take place in the UK on November 26 and 27, 2026. A virtual one-on-one meeting with Millenium is scheduled for December 2, 2026, in Mumbai. These meetings are subject to change. Corporate and earnings presentations hosted on the company website and other publicly available information will be shared during these sessions.

attchmntText: Polycab India Limited has informed the Exchange about Analyst(s)/Investor(s) meet.
voiceSummary: Polycab India Limited has intimated the exchange regarding investor meetings scheduled for November 20, 2026. The company will hold a one-on-one virtual meeting with GIC in Mumbai. Additionally, an in-person meeting is planned with BNP Paribas. These engagements are subject to change. The presentations will be limited to corporate and earnings information already available on the company website and other public sources. No material non-public information will be shared. The notice was issued by Manita Carmen A. Gonsalves, Vice President-Legal and Company Secretary. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
